title: HDehydrated Herbal Glassy-jelly Pilaf
description: A comforting Filipino dish featuring dehydrated green beans and herbs that are both Paleo-friendly and glassy-jelly in texture.
instructions: In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Stir in ginger powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for another minute to toast the spices slightly.
Pour in the dehydrated green beans and stir well to coat them evenly with the spice mixture.
Drizzle in the lime juice and mix thoroughly until there are no clumps of dehydrated beans left.
Serve warm as a side dish or over a bed of greens for a more substantial meal.
